items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: because I went in to lead the Teen Time Show on television. Actually I had Ronny Lang, Ted Nash was in there

ctx.x: Of course I remember it yeah. This is while I was in Hollywood, and at that time, because I went in to lead the Teen Time Show on television. Actually I had Ronny Lang, Ted Nash was in there, a bunch of studio players now. And that was my thing before going with Peggy Lee, with Jimmy Rowles, Joe Mondragon, Jack Costanzo was on bongos, like a lover, like “When You’re Near Me” and all of that. And we stayed with him for about a year, year and a half, and played places — New York, we’d be on the road for six weeks,…
Is there a west coast jazz sound to your ears?
